design.scope: Synthetic bounded binary sequences in one frame; no external task, language, vision or general-capability claim
design.transfer: Unseen sequence draws and distinct case ids; same law, frame and input distribution, no re-used draw

baseline.majority: Persistence: always predict the training split majority label
baseline.memoryless: Predict positive iff the final step is 1; a deterministic model with no memory of the sequence

design.primary: Accuracy of the local recurrent model on the holdout and transfer splits, paired against both baselines
design.uncertainty: Conservative bounded synthetic case score: mean(delta)-sqrt(2*log(20)/n) on 0/1 outcomes; no real-task population CI claim

metrics.calibration: NOT_MEASURED: the readout score is not a calibrated probability and no outcome-probability pairing is declared in this slice

mutations: count the training split as holdout
killCriteria: design, fixture or environment digest mismatch
any external call or token usage
accuracy gain below the lower bound
design.promotion: No automatic model, memory or graph-rule promotion; KEEP is experimental only
